name: Mackerel, Petit Pois & Feta Smash
notes:
A protein-packed smoosh for a bagel, toast or pitta. Mob's figures don't include bread for this one.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 150g petit pois
• 420g smoked mackerel
• 20g mint
• 1 lemon
• 200g feta
• 1 tbsp Tabasco
• Salt

Method:
1. Boil the petit pois (or regular peas) for 1–2 mins. Roughly chop the mackerel and mint and juice the lemon.
2. Combine everything in a bowl, then smoosh over toast, pitta, a bagel or whatever you fancy.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 21g, fibre 6g, sugars 8g, sodium 2800mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/mackerel-petit-pois-feta-smoosh
